paper.title: SEAgent: Self-Evolving Computer Use Agent with Autonomous Learning from Experience
paper.central_claim: 通过World State Model、持续更新的软件guidebook与课程生成、GRPO和失败动作惩罚，以及specialist-to-generalist训练，使CUA自主掌握陌生软件，OSWorld五软件SR从11.3%升至34.5%。
paper.scope_reason: guidebook为被下一轮课程生成器实际读取的非权重状态；评价混合系统，不把权重提升单独当Harness RSI。

provenance.notes: 派发type=sonnet，目标gpt-6.1-sol；运行环境声明同名模型，但无可核验实际模型receipt或session标识，按模板留null。未读取其他席/批/attempt判断；无联网及代码执行。

materials.notes: manifest标完整HTML文本；图内prompt/guidebook未转成文本处不推断其内容；无page_images资产。

evidence.quote: In each phase, these tasks are executed and step-wise evaluated. The resulting judgments and descriptions of the exploration trajectories are fed into the Curriculum Generator
evidence.support_explanation: 执行反馈进入课程生成器；同段随后的guidebook更新与下一阶段生成构成非权重闭环。

evidence.quote: acts as the system’s long-term memory, driving the Curriculum Generator to propose increasingly sophisticated and unexplored tasks in subsequent rounds, thereby guiding the agent toward mastery.
evidence.support_explanation: guidebook被留存，后续由任务生成器读取而非直接证明执行器记忆收益。

evidence.quote: All results are averaged over three runs.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告重复次数，不报告跨运行spread。

evidence.quote: from 11.3% to 34.5%. Furthermore, SEAgent with the specialist-to-generalist strategy (34.5%) outperforms both specialist RL (32.2%) and generalist RL (30.6%) by a substantial margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of the specialist-to-generalist paradigm.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告的主结果；不等同guidebook贡献或本席复现。

evidence.quote: The tasks generated by each strategy were used to train an RL agent (using GRPO only), with reward signals uniformly provided by our fine-tuned WSM.
evidence.support_explanation: 课程替代策略比较有共同RL/WSM，但没有独立guidebook-off控制。

evidence.quote: In contrast, our guidebook-based method, while having a lower initial data generation efficiency, excels at systematic exploration.
evidence.support_explanation: VSCode并非一致优于NNetNav；Celestia结果支持限定的新软件探索收益，不证明通用最优。

evidence.quote: Firstly, our self evolving agent system is bounded by GUI-Judge to provide reliable reward signal instead of real signal from environment.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练奖励是模型代理，作者承认可靠性边界。

evidence.quote: Only samples where the judgment matched the ground truth from OSWorld evaluation protocols were retained, resulting in 860 high-quality annotated trajectories.
evidence.support_explanation: WSM教师数据有规则锚；不是完全零外部监督。训练Chrome，跨软件与AgentRewardBench验证。

evidence.quote: Training is conducted for 1k iterations on 8 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs,
evidence.support_explanation: 每阶段训练资源可见；三阶段及五specialist+SFT+generalist增加成本，没有端到端GPU时/教师调用总账。

evidence.quote: However, providing too many descriptions (e.g., 200) creates an overly long context for the LLM, which degrades the quality of task generation and hurts final performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 存储/输入增长有明确失败边界，但无长期合并删除回退协议。

evidence.quote: Based on the observed evolution curves, we set the number of training phases to three, as performance gains saturate beyond that point.
evidence.support_explanation: 阶段数使用观察曲线选择；独立冻结选择/评测视图及去重审计不足。

evidence.quote: and rule-based evaluation is used as ground-truth supervision. We then compute the confusion matrix by comparing the predictions of different reward models against these labels.
evidence.support_explanation: WSM评测基于339 feasible OSWorld任务与规则标签，测量有锚，不能由训练代理误差直接否定最终SR指标。
